atoms.exact_source_text: The v0.5 philosophical and manifestation specifications: Home/Away subject split, shared world state, attachment-first stewardship, and the universal preparation–departure–risk–return cycle.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away declares the v0.5 philosophical and manifestation specifications as source bases, contributing the Home/Away subject split, shared world state, attachment-first stewardship, and the universal preparation-departure-risk-return cycle.

atoms.exact_source_text: This is not a restatement of v0.4.7.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away states it is not a restatement of v0.4.7.

atoms.exact_source_text: It is a governed revision.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away describes itself as a governed revision.

atoms.exact_source_text: Where the older log and today’s v0.5 work disagree, v0.5 leads.
atoms.normalized_claim: Where the older log and v0.5 work disagree, v0.5 leads.

atoms.exact_source_text: Useful structures are preserved;
atoms.normalized_claim: Useful structures from the older material are preserved.

atoms.exact_source_text: contradictory assumptions are explicitly superseded rather than silently carried forward.
atoms.normalized_claim: Contradictory assumptions are explicitly superseded rather than silently carried forward.

atoms.exact_source_text: Four Registers only; no fifth Register
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition: four Registers only, no fifth Register.

atoms.exact_source_text: Superseded by EMBODY
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.5 ruling: the four-Register-only proposition is superseded by EMBODY.

atoms.exact_source_text: Away retains TRAVEL, RISK, and MEET; Home retains DWELL and EMBODY; MEET remains cross-modal.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence: Away retains TRAVEL, RISK, and MEET; Home retains DWELL and EMBODY; MEET remains cross-modal.

atoms.exact_source_text: Encounter verb INTERACT
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition: Encounter verb was INTERACT, superseded by MEET.

atoms.exact_source_text: A colony may meet wind; an expedition may meet a stranger, a resource, a blockage, or a need.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence of MEET verb: a colony may meet wind; an expedition may meet a stranger, a resource, a blockage, or a need.

atoms.exact_source_text: Field can remain Home before anyone crosses
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition: Field can remain Home before anyone crosses, superseded by the simulation-scale split.

atoms.exact_source_text: The Mode changes at Launch. TRAVEL on the Home Reach is already Away because particular Citizens are now the crunch subject.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence: the Mode changes at Launch, and TRAVEL on the Home Reach is already Away because particular Citizens are the crunch subject.

atoms.exact_source_text: Exposure reserved for contested Encounters
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition: Exposure reserved for contested Encounters, now superseded.

atoms.exact_source_text: Personal Exposure may arise through TRAVEL, RISK, or MEET. Each Register creates it differently.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence: Personal Exposure may arise through TRAVEL, RISK, or MEET, each Register creating it differently.

atoms.exact_source_text: Crossing has no Exposure
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition 'Crossing has no Exposure' is superseded.

atoms.exact_source_text: Crossing does not use the MEET Exposure procedure, but its bodily danger can add Exposure, wounds, fear, separation, cargo loss, or Tharn.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence: Crossing does not use the MEET Exposure procedure, but its bodily danger can add Exposure, wounds, fear, separation, cargo loss, or Tharn.

atoms.exact_source_text: Fixed five Approaches everywhere
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition: fixed five Approaches everywhere, now narrowed.

atoms.exact_source_text: The fixed five remain the provisional grammar of contested Away MEET only. Home MEET uses the v0.5 two-spend-or-refuse structure.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence: the fixed five remain the provisional grammar of contested Away MEET only; Home MEET uses the v0.5 two-spend-or-refuse structure.

atoms.exact_source_text: 70/20/10 return Crossing roll
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition: 70/20/10 return Crossing roll, replaced by burden-based return logic.

atoms.exact_source_text: The return Crossing is elided, abbreviated, or played in full according to time, load, injury, route familiarity, and traffic conditions.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence: the return Crossing is elided, abbreviated, or played in full according to time, load, injury, route familiarity, and traffic conditions.

atoms.exact_source_text: Held Reach carries partial Home state
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition 'Held Reach carries partial Home state' is narrowed to refuge.

atoms.exact_source_text: An outpost supports Stopover, rest, care, warning, and storage, but not full DWELL, Quiet Equilibrium, or EMBODY.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence: an outpost supports Stopover, rest, care, warning, and storage, but not full DWELL, Quiet Equilibrium, or EMBODY.

atoms.exact_source_text: Experienced Home workers fare better off-screen
atoms.normalized_claim: v0.4.7 proposition: experienced Home workers fare better off-screen, now superseded.

atoms.exact_source_text: Home outcome depends on remaining Role Capacity, Places, topology, and Readiness—not personal productivity aptitude.
atoms.normalized_claim: Consequence: Home outcome depends on remaining Role Capacity, Places, topology, and Readiness, not personal productivity aptitude.

atoms.exact_source_text: No Away rule may weaken the clarity of the v0.5 Home Loop.
atoms.normalized_claim: Revision test: no Away rule may weaken the clarity of the v0.5 Home Loop.

atoms.exact_source_text: Departure must create a legible domestic subtraction; return must convert particular consequences back into Colony posture.
atoms.normalized_claim: Revision test: departure must create a legible domestic subtraction, and return must convert particular consequences back into Colony posture.

atoms.exact_source_text: Away Mode is the expedition architecture of MEDIAN.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away Mode is defined as the expedition architecture of MEDIAN.

atoms.exact_source_text: It begins when named Citizens leave domestic stewardship and become a particular party committed to distance, risk, opportunity, and return.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away Mode begins when named Citizens leave domestic stewardship and become a particular party committed to distance, risk, opportunity, and return.

atoms.exact_source_text: Its subject is not abstract exploration progress.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away Mode's subject is not abstract exploration progress.

atoms.exact_source_text: Its subject is what happens to these friends because they chose to carry the Colony’s need beyond sanctuary.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away Mode's subject is what happens to these particular friends because they chose to carry the Colony's need beyond sanctuary.

atoms.exact_source_text: Away Mode carries particular Citizens through extended territory, immediate highway danger, and bounded consequential situations.
atoms.normalized_claim: Canonical definition: Away Mode carries particular Citizens through extended territory, immediate highway danger, and bounded consequential situations.

atoms.exact_source_text: It accumulates material, knowledge, relationships, wounds, Exposure, and memory until Homecoming returns those facts to the Colony.
atoms.normalized_claim: Away Mode accumulates material, knowledge, relationships, wounds, Exposure, and memory until Homecoming returns those facts to the Colony.
